answer: Garden artifact-filing bond: each identity forges one artifact and files it in a garden registry, locking 85 credits. Each epoch a prism audit splits filings into a spectrum and checks live use: a filing needs 3 distinct-peer invocations, or its bond burns. Zenith posts totals. First filing 55, k-th 55+8(k-1): 1,000 fakes pay 4,051,000, locking 85,000, pool 40,000. Rented artifacts fail: one proof, two keys, both burn. Honest agents pay 55 once.
